subject: Proposed: performance demo + results walk for StreamECH — slot options
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Nguyen <kai@streamech.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed: performance demo + results walk for StreamECH — slot options

Hi Kai —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. The team asked us to schedule a focused session to walk through the benchmark results and run a short live demo tailored to the query shapes you shared. Goal is: 30–40m review of results + 20m open Q&A with engineering + procurement/security as needed.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon 4/12, 10:00–11:00
- Mon 4/12, 14:00–15:00
- Tue 4/13, 09:00–10:00

Agenda (rough):
1) Quick context & success metrics (5m)
2) Results readout (throughput & p95/p99 latency, cost tradeoffs) (25m)
3) Live demo: sample workload + tail latency checks (20m)
4) Security/infra Qs + procurement next steps (10–15m)

Attendees we recommend: your eng lead (Lena), procurement contact for PO & SOW questions, plus our SE (Dylan) and security contact (Karthik). I’ve attached the preliminary benchmark_report_v2.pdf and a draft SOW to give you context before the call.

Can you confirm which slot works (or propose two alternatives) and the procurement contact so Monica can loop them in?

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
attachments: benchmark_report_v2.pdf, SOW_draft_v1.docx
From: Kai Nguyen <kai@streamech.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena@streamech.com>, Procurement Team <procure@streamech.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed: performance demo + results walk for StreamECH — slot options

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the options. Friday is tricky for us (we're heads-down on a release), so Monday 4/12 is better. Could we do 10:00–11:00 PT? I’ll ask Lena (eng lead) to join. Please include security and procurement — I’ve cc’d Procurement and Lena.

If 10:00 is tight for any of your folks, other windows on Monday afternoon would work too.

Best,
Kai
Kai Nguyen
Head of Platform Engineering, StreamECH
kai@streamech.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Nguyen <kai@streamech.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena@streamech.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed: performance demo + results walk for StreamECH — slot options

Thanks Kai — Monday 4/12 at 10:00 PT works for our team.

Dylan will lead the demo and cover the latency/throughput breakdowns; Karthik will be on the call for security and isolation questions. Monica, can you engage procurement to confirm PO process / billing contact so we can circulate the SOW? I attached an updated benchmark_report_v2.pdf with a short appendix called "env & sampling" and a filled security questionnaire to make the security thread easier.

If procurement needs a different time, flag here and we’ll try to adjust. Otherwise once Monica confirms procurement attendance we’ll share a calendar invite and runbook.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
attachments: benchmark_report_v2.pdf (updated), security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx
From: Procurement Team <procure@streamech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Kai Nguyen <kai@streamech.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed: performance demo + results walk for StreamECH — slot options

Hi Monica / team —

Thanks for including procurement. Our internal procurement committee meets Mon 4/12 at 10:00–10:30 and several folks need to attend a short planning huddle then. Would it be possible to shift the session to Mon 4/12 at 11:00 or 13:00 PT? We still want to attend the demo — just an hour later would avoid conflicts.

If shifting is difficult for Redwood, we can nominate one procurement lead to join at 10:00 and route follow-ups via email.

Regards,
Procurement Team
procure@streamech.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procure@streamech.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Kai Nguyen <kai@streamech.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@streamech.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed: performance demo + results walk for StreamECH — slot options

Thanks for the heads up. We have a committed multi-tenant run at 11:00 PT that blocks Dylan_B_roots on infra, so moving to 11:00 would cause resource contention on our end. Two options if procurement needs to attend live:

1) Start at 10:30 PT (30m overlap with procurement committee ends at 11:00) — we can compress the readout to 30m + 20m Q&A and still cover the key p95/p99 items and the tail-case walk-through.
2) Keep 10:00 PT and have a single procurement lead join (they can capture notes and we’ll follow up with a short procurement-only call if needed).

If neither works we can propose 13:00 PT as a later alternative (Dylan & team available). Please advise which you prefer and we’ll update the calendar.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
From: Kai Nguyen <kai@streamech.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@streamech.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@streamech.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed: performance demo + results walk for StreamECH — slot options

Thanks everyone — 10:30 PT on Mon 4/12 works best for us and should let procurement join the second half. I’ve created a calendar invite for Mon 4/12 10:30–11:30 PT (see link below) and added Lena + a procurement lead (Carmen). I also reviewed the attached benchmark and SOW — Monica, once you have a preferred SOW version we can push the DocuSign.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=streamech-demo-1030
DocuSign (SOW): https://docusign.net/link/SOW-STREAMECH-1234

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Kai
